literature_notes: All five ledger lines describe tags at topologically intracellular termini. L1 and L2 (PMC4551902) place a c-Myc epitope 'in front of the first ATG', i.e. prepended to residue 1; the computed topology assigns residues 1–40 to the intracellular face, so this tag faces the cytoplasm. L3 (PMC4551902) confirms surface trafficking of the c-Myc-AQP7 G264V construct but does not relocate the tag — it remains at the intracellular N-terminus; G264 itself falls in TM6 (253–276) and is not an insertion site. L4 and L5 (PMC7339978) place a myc-HIS tag at the C-terminus; residues 277–342 are intracellular. AQP7 has three extracellular loops (EC1: 60–67, 8 aa; EC2: 134–167, 34 aa; EC3: 221–252, 32 aa), but no ledger line reports any insertion in any of them. Zero surface tag sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: c-Myc epitope inserted before residue 1 (N-terminal prepend); the N-terminus (residues 1–40) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
